proposals.title: Change of economic system
proposals.body:
Vote on the proposal to change the economic model of the NFT Mythical Beings collection. A decision will be taken on the proposed package of measures and, if approved, will be implemented immediately.
The proposal and its discussion are available at https://dao.mythicalbeings.io/forum/post/new_economics_for_s07_fc96gzcf
proposals.author: 0xc4CCC6A11329558582c2dA79C18a9AEaC00f59F9

proposals.title: Subsidy for representatives in NFC Lisbon 2024
proposals.body:
Proposal to subsidize part of the travel costs of DAO members travelling to Lisbon for the Non Fungible conference to represent the Mythical DAO and work on the Mythical Beings stand.
https://www.nonfungibleconference.com/

proposals.title: S08 American Beings
proposals.body:
Choose the being that will be reinterpreted by Ana Santiso for the eighth season among the following:
1. Curupira.
2. Hah-nu-nah.
3. Teju Jagua.
4. Lobison.

Discussion in the private Discord channel.

More information about each candidate can be found at this link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1MvjdCeUAIlO7bW0lyyuu_I6dRGCc69xOm3tm4Qu-U48/edit?usp=sharing
